en.title: Vote counting continues after US midterms as Republicans select new leadership
en.dek: Election officials continue counting ballots one week after the vote while party leaders are selected and key races are resolved.
facts: Vote counting continues one week after the 2026 midterm elections with 17 races still undecided, according to G1.
Republican Party selected Jim Jordan and John Thune as new House leaders following election losses, according to the New York Times.
More than a dozen key races remain too early to call one week after Election Day, according to PBS and Al Jazeera.
Meta was fined by Brazil's electoral court following a complaint by President Lula's coalition, according to DW and The Hindu.
Nearly half of MAGA supporters view the movement as the loser in the midterms, according to a Politico survey cited by The Hill and The Guardian.
Republican Greg Murphy conceded his North Carolina House race to Democrat Raymond Smith, according to The Hill and AP News.
body: Election officials are still counting ballots eight days after the midterm elections, according to G1. A total of 17 races remain without a final declared result as counting proceeds across multiple states.
More than a dozen key races remain too early to call one week after Election Day, according to PBS and Al Jazeera, as vote counting continues across multiple states.

The Republican Party has chosen Jim Jordan and John Thune as their new leaders in the House of Representatives, according to the New York Times. The party sought fresh leadership following their defeat in the 2026 midterm elections.

A new poll from Politico found 45 percent of MAGA supporters of President Trump said the movement was the loser in last year's midterms, according to The Hill. The Guardian reports the survey shows nearly half of MAGA Trump supporters view the movement as a loser.
Brazil's electoral court fined Meta after President Lula's coalition filed a complaint; the court found no evidence of deliberate election bias, according to DW and The Hindu.

Republican Greg Murphy conceded his reelection race to Democrat Raymond Smith, flipping another House seat for Democrats after a close contest in North Carolina’s 3rd Congressional District, according to The Hill and AP News.

Democrat Scott Colom defeated incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith to win the US Senate seat from Mississippi, according to multiple projections. The victory gives Democrats a Senate majority, according to AP News and The Washington Post.
en.context: The 2026 US midterm elections resulted in several undecided congressional races, leading to leadership adjustments within the Republican Party, while international courts addressed separate cases related to election platform management.

en.dek: Election officials continue counting ballots eight days after the US midterms while a new survey measures Republican voter reactions and party leaders select House leadership.
body: A new Politico survey shows 45 percent of President Donald Trump's MAGA supporters described the movement as the loser in last year's midterm elections, according to reports by The Hill and The Guardian. The survey results were released as political parties evaluate the outcomes of the vote.

Election officials are still counting ballots eight days after the midterm elections, according to G1. A total of 17 races remain without a final declared result as counting proceeds across multiple states.

The Republican Party has selected Representative Jim Jordan and Senator John Thune as their new leaders in the House of Representatives, according to the New York Times. The decisions followed election losses in the 2026 midterm vote.

Dawn reported that Donald Trump has issued mixed signals regarding his political plans following the midterm election results. The outlet noted contrasting messages from the former president as party members assess the political landscape.

In related international developments, Brazil's electoral court imposed a fine on Meta following a complaint submitted by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's political coalition, according to DW and The Hindu. The electoral court stated that it found no evidence of deliberate election bias by the company.

en.headline: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat
en.body: Scott Colom defeated incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith to win the US Senate seat from Mississippi, according to multiple projections. The victory gives Democrats a Senate majority, according to AP News and The Washington Post.

fr.headline: Scott Colom démocrate remporte le siège au Sénat du Mississippi
fr.body: Scott Colom a battu la sortante Cindy Hyde-Smith, républicaine, pour remporter le siège au Sénat américain du Mississippi, selon plusieurs projections. La victoire donne la majorité au Sénat aux démocrates, selon l'AP et Le Washington Post.

es.headline: Demócrata Scott Colom gana escaño en el Senado de Mississippi
es.body: Scott Colom derrotó a la republicana Cindy Hyde-Smith para ganar el escaño en el Senado de EE. UU. por Mississippi, según múltiples proyecciones. La victoria otorga a los demócratas la mayoría en el Senado, según AP News y The Washington Post.

de.headline: Demokrat Scott Colom gewinnt Mississippi-Senatsitz
de.body: Scott Colom besiegte die amtierende Republikanerin Cindy Hyde-Smith und gewinnt den US-Senatsitz von Mississippi, laut mehreren Projektionen. Der Sieg gibt den Demokraten eine Senatsmehrheit, laut AP News und The Washington Post.

ja.headline: 民主党のスコット・コロム氏、ミシシッピ州上院議席を獲得
ja.body: スコット・コロム氏が現職の共和党員シンディ・ハイド＝スミス氏を破り、ミシシッピ州選出の米上院議席を獲得したと、複数の予測が示した。AP通信とワシントン・ポストによると、この勝利により民主党が上院で過半数を獲得する。

zh.headline: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆赢得密西西比州参议院席位
zh.body: 据多家预测，斯科特·科洛姆击败共和党现任参议员辛迪·海德-史密斯，赢得密西西比州美国参议院席位。据美联社和《华盛顿邮报》报道，此次胜利使民主党获得参议院多数席位。

ko.headline: 민주당 스콧 콜롬, 미시시피 연방상원의석 획득
ko.body: 스콧 콜롬이 현직 공화당 소속 신디 하이드스미스를 꺾고 미시시피 연방상원의석을 차지했다고 여러 전망기관이 밝혔다. AP통신과 워싱턴포스트에 따르면 이 승리로 민주당은 상원 다수당 지위를 확보했다.

pt.headline: Democrata Scott Colom vence lugar no Senado pelo Mississippi
pt.body: Scott Colom derrotou a republicana Cindy Hyde-Smith, em funções, e conquistou o lugar no Senado dos EUA pelo Mississippi, segundo várias projeções. A vitória dá aos democratas a maioria no Senado, segundo a AP News e o The Washington Post.

it.headline: Il democratico Scott Colom vince il seggio al Senato per il Mississippi
it.body: Scott Colom ha sconfitto la repubblicana uscente Cindy Hyde-Smith aggiudicandosi il seggio al Senato degli Stati Uniti per il Mississippi, secondo diverse proiezioni. La vittoria dà ai democratici la maggioranza al Senato, secondo AP News e The Washington Post.

en.headline: Republicans concede North Carolina House race
en.body: Rep. Greg Murphy conceded his reelection race to Democrat Raymond Smith, flipping another House seat for Democrats after a close contest in North Carolina’s 3rd Congressional District, according to The Hill and AP News.

fr.headline: Les républicains concèdent la course à la Chambre en Caroline du Nord
fr.body: Le représentant Greg Murphy a concédé sa course à la réélection face au démocrate Raymond Smith, basculant un autre siège à la Chambre des représentants pour les démocrates après un scrutin serré dans le 3e district congressionnel de Caroline du Nord, selon The Hill et l'AP.

es.headline: Republicanos reconocen la derrota en la carrera por la Cámara de Representantes de Carolina del Norte
es.body: El representante Greg Murphy reconoció su derrota ante el demócrata Raymond Smith en su carrera a la reelección, volviendo a cambiar un escaño en la Cámara de Representantes para los demócratas tras un ajustado concurso en el Distrito Congressional 3 de Carolina del Norte, según The Hill y AP News.

de.headline: Republikaner räumen North Carolina House Race ein
de.body: Abgeordneter Greg Murphy räumte seine Wiederwahlkampf gegen Demokrat Raymond Smith ein und kippt weitere House-Sitz für Demokraten nach einem engen Rennen im North Carolina’s 3rd Congressional District, laut The Hill und AP News.

ja.headline: 共和党、ノースカロライナ州下院選で敗北認める
ja.body: グレッグ・マーフィー下院議員は、再選を目指した選挙で民主党のレイモンド・スミス氏に敗北を認めた。ザ・ヒルとAP通信によると、ノースカロライナ州第3選挙区の接戦の末、民主党はさらに下院議席を1つ獲得した。

zh.headline: 共和党承认北卡罗来纳州众议院选举失利
zh.body: 据《国会山报》和美联社报道，众议员格雷格·墨菲承认在连任竞选中不敌民主党人雷蒙德·史密斯。在北卡罗来纳州第三国会选区经过激烈角逐后，民主党又翻转了一个众议院席位。

ko.headline: 공화당, 노스캐롤라이나 연방하원 선거 패배 인정
ko.body: 그레그 머피 연방하원의원이 민주당 레이먼드 스미스에게 재선 경쟁에서 패배를 인정했다. 더힐과 AP통신에 따르면 노스캐롤라이나 제3선거구에서 접전 끝에 민주당이 또 다른 연방하원의석을 차지했다.

pt.headline: Republicanos reconhecem derrota na corrida à Câmara na Carolina do Norte
pt.body: O representante Greg Murphy reconheceu a derrota na sua corrida à reeleição para o democrata Raymond Smith, fazendo passar mais um lugar na Câmara para os democratas após uma disputa renhida no 3.º Distrito Congressional da Carolina do Norte, segundo o The Hill e a AP News.

it.headline: I repubblicani ammettono la sconfitta nella corsa alla Camera in Carolina del Nord
it.body: Il deputato Greg Murphy ha ammesso la sconfitta nella corsa alla rielezione contro il democratico Raymond Smith, ribaltando a favore dei democratici un altro seggio alla Camera dopo una contesa serrata nel 3º distretto congressuale della Carolina del Nord, secondo The Hill e AP News.

en.headline: More than a dozen key races remain undecided
en.body: More than a dozen key races remain too early to call one week after Election Day, according to PBS and Al Jazeera, as vote counting continues across multiple states.

fr.headline: Plus d'une douzaine de courses clés restent indécises
fr.body: Plus d'une douzaine de courses clés restent trop tôt pour être décidées une semaine après le scrutin, selon PBS et Al Jazeera, alors que le dépouillement se poursuit dans plusieurs États.

es.headline: Más de una docena de carreras clave siguen sin decidirse
es.body: Más de una docena de carreras clave siguen siendo demasiado temprano para llamarlas una semana después del Día de Elecciones, según PBS y Al Jazeera, mientras continúa el recuento de votos en varios estados.

de.headline: Mehr als ein Dutzend Schlüsselwettkämpfe unentschieden
de.body: Mehr als ein Dutzend Schlüsselwettkämpfe sind nach einer Woche nach dem Wahltag noch zu früh für einen Ruf, laut PBS und Al Jazeera, da die Stimmenzählung in mehreren Bundesstaaten weitergeht.

ja.headline: 主要選挙の十数件、結果未確定
ja.body: PBSとアルジャジーラによると、選挙日から1週間が経過しても、主要な選挙の十数件は勝敗を判断するのが早すぎる状況が続いている。複数の州で開票作業が続いているためだ。

zh.headline: 十余场关键选举仍未决出
zh.body: 据PBS和半岛电视台报道，选举日一周后，仍有十余场关键选举因计票工作在多州持续进行而难以判定结果。

ko.headline: 주요 선거 12개 이상, 승부 아직 안 갈라
ko.body: 선거일로부터 일주일이 지났지만 주요 경합 선거 12개 이상은 아직 승패를 가리기 이르다고 PBS와 알자지라가 전했다. 여러 주에서 개표가 계속되고 있다.

pt.headline: Mais de uma dezena de corridas-chave continuam indefinidas
pt.body: Mais de uma dezena de corridas-chave continuam sem ser possível anunciar um vencedor uma semana após o Dia das Eleições, segundo a PBS e a Al Jazeera, enquanto a contagem dos votos continua em vários estados.

it.headline: Più di una dozzina di elezioni chiave rimangono indecise
it.body: Più di una dozzina di elezioni chiave rimangono troppo presto per definirle una settimana dopo il giorno delle elezioni, secondo PBS e Al Jazeera, mentre il conteggio dei voti continua in diversi stati.

de.body: Eine neue Umfrage von Politico ergab, dass 45 Prozent der MAGA-Anhänger von Präsident Trump sagten, die Bewegung sei bei den Zwischenwahlen des vergangenen Jahres die Verliererin gewesen, laut The Hill. The Guardian berichtet, die Umfrage zeige fast die Hälfte der MAGA-Anhänger von Trump, die Bewegung als Verlierer zu betrachten.
de.headline: Fast die Hälfte der MAGA-Anhänger sieht Bewegung als Verlierer bei den Zwischenwahlen: Umfrage

en.body: A new poll from Politico found 45 percent of MAGA supporters of President Trump said the movement was the loser in last year's midterms, according to The Hill. The Guardian reports the survey shows nearly half of MAGA Trump supporters view the movement as a loser.
en.headline: Nearly half of MAGA supporters call movement a loser in midterms: Survey

es.body: Una nueva encuesta de Politico encontró que el 45 por ciento de los seguidores de MAGA del presidente Trump dijeron que el movimiento fue el perdedor en las pasadas elecciones de mitad de mandato, según The Hill. The Guardian informa que la encuesta muestra que casi la mitad de los seguidores de MAGA de Trump ven al movimiento como un perdedor.
es.headline: Casi la mitad de los seguidores de MAGA consideran al movimiento un perdedor en las elecciones de mitad de mandato: encuesta

fr.body: Un nouveau sondage de Politico a révélé que 45 % des partisans du MAGA du président Trump ont déclaré que le mouvement était le perdant des dernières élections de mi-mandat, selon The Hill. Le Guardian rapporte que le sondage montre près de la moitié des partisans du MAGA de Trump considèrent le mouvement comme un perdant.
fr.headline: Presque la moitié des partisans du MAGA qualifient le mouvement de perdant dans les élections de mi-mandat : sondage

it.body: Un nuovo sondaggio di Politico ha rilevato che il 45% dei sostenitori di Trump, del Presidente, ha definito il movimento un fallimento nelle elezioni di metà mandato dell'anno scorso, secondo The Hill. The Guardian riporta che il sondaggio mostra che quasi metà dei sostenitori MAGA di Trump considera il movimento un fallimento.
it.headline: Quasi metà dei sostenitori MAGA definisce il movimento un fallimento alle elezioni di metà mandato: Sondaggio

ja.body: Politicoによる新たな世論調査によると、トランプ大統領のMAGA支持者の45パーセントが、昨年の中間選挙でこの運動は敗者であったと回答したとThe Hillが報じた。ガーディアン紙は、この調査がMAGAトランプ支持者のほぼ半数がこの運動を敗者と見なしていることを示していると伝えている。
ja.headline: MAGA支持者の約半数が中間選挙で運動を敗者と見なす：調査

ko.body: 폴리티코의 새로운 여론조사에 따르면, 트럼프 대통령의 MAGA 지지자 중 45%가 지난해 중간선거에서 이 운동이 패배했다고 응답했으며, 이는 더 힐(The Hill)이 보도한 내용이다. 가디언(The Guardian)은 이 설문조사가 MAGA 트럼프 지지자 중 거의 절반이 이 운동을 패배로 간주하고 있음을 보여준다고 보도했다.
ko.headline: MAGA 지지자 중 거의 절반이 중간선거에서 운동이 패배했다고 응답: 설문조사

pt.body: Uma nova sondagem da Politico revelou que 45 por cento dos apoiantes do Presidente Trump, do MAGA, consideraram o movimento perdedor nas eleições de meio de mandato do ano passado, segundo The Hill. O The Guardian reporta que a sondagem mostra que quase metade dos apoiantes MAGA de Trump vê o movimento como perdedor.
pt.headline: Quase metade dos apoiantes MAGA considera o movimento perdedor nas eleições de meio de mandato: Inquérito

zh.body: 据The Hill报道，Politico的一项新民调显示，45%的特朗普MAGA支持者认为该运动在去年的中期选举中是失败的。卫报报道称，该调查显示近半数的MAGA特朗普支持者认为该运动是失败的。
zh.headline: 近半MAGA支持者称运动在中期选举中是失败者：调查

de.body: Das brasilianische Wahlgericht hat Meta wegen einer Klage der Koalition von Präsident Lula bestraft. Das Gericht fand nach Angaben von DW und The Hindu keine Beweise für vorsichtige Wahlbeeinträchtigung.
de.headline: Brasilien: Wahlgericht verurteilt Meta wegen Behauptungen von Wahleinflussnahme

en.body: Brazil's electoral court fined Meta after President Lula's coalition filed a complaint; the court found no evidence of deliberate election bias, according to DW and The Hindu.
en.headline: Meta fined by Brazil electoral court over election bias claims

es.body: El tribunal electoral de Brasil multó a Meta tras una denuncia presentada por la coalición del presidente Lula; el tribunal no encontró pruebas de sesgo electoral deliberado, según DW y The Hindu.
es.headline: Meta multada por el tribunal electoral de Brasil por alegaciones de sesgo electoral

fr.body: Le tribunal électoral brésilien a condamné Meta après le dépôt d'une plainte par la coalition du président Lula ; le tribunal n'a trouvé aucune preuve de biais électoral délibéré, selon DW et The Hindu.
fr.headline: Meta condamnée par le tribunal électoral brésilien pour allégations de biais électoral

it.body: La corte elettorale brasiliana ha multato Meta dopo che la coalizione del presidente Lula ha presentato una denuncia; la corte ha rilevato l'assenza di prove di parzialità elettorale deliberata, secondo DW e The Hindu.
it.headline: Meta multata dalla corte elettorale brasiliana per le accuse di parzialità elettorale

ja.body: ブラジルの選挙裁判所は、ルラ大統領の連合が申し立てを行った後、Metaに罰金を科しました。DWとThe Hinduによると、裁判所は意図的な選挙偏向の証拠は見つからなかったとしています。
ja.headline: ブラジルの選挙裁判所、選挙偏向の申し立てでMetaに罰金

ko.body: 브라질 선거관리위원회는 룰라 대통령 연합이 제기한 고소에 따라 메타에 벌금을 부과했으며, DW와 The Hindu에 따르면 법원은 고의적인 선거 편향성에 대한 증거를 발견하지 못했다.
ko.headline: 브라질 선거관리위원회, 선거 편향성 주장으로 메타에 벌금 부과

pt.body: O tribunal eleitoral brasileiro multou a Meta após a coligação do Presidente Lula apresentar uma queixa; o tribunal não encontrou provas de viés eleitoral deliberado, segundo DW e The Hindu.
pt.headline: Meta multada pelo tribunal eleitoral brasileiro por alegações de viés eleitoral

zh.body: 根据DW和《印度时报》报道，在卢拉总统的联盟提出申诉后，巴西选举法院罚款Meta；法院未发现故意选举偏见的证据。
zh.headline: 巴西选举法院因选举偏见指控罚款Meta

de.body: Die Republikanische Partei hat laut der New York Times Jim Jordan und John Thune zu ihren neuen Führungskräften im Repräsentantenhaus gewählt. Die Partei strebte nach ihrer Niederlage bei den Zwischenwahlen 2026 eine personelle Erneuerung an.
de.headline: Republikaner wählen nach Verlusten bei den Zwischenwahlen neue Führung im Repräsentantenhaus

en.body: The Republican Party has chosen Jim Jordan and John Thune as their new leaders in the House of Representatives, according to the New York Times. The party sought fresh leadership following their defeat in the 2026 midterm elections.
en.headline: Republicans select new House leadership following midterm losses

es.body: El Partido Republicano ha elegido a Jim Jordan y John Thune como sus nuevos líderes en la Cámara de Representantes, según el New York Times. El partido buscó un liderazgo renovado tras su derrota en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de 2026.
es.headline: Republicanos eligen nuevo liderazgo en la Cámara tras pérdidas en las elecciones de mitad de mandato

fr.body: Le Parti républicain a choisi Jim Jordan et John Thune comme nouveaux chefs à la Chambre des représentants, selon le New York Times. Le parti cherchait à renouveler sa direction à la suite de sa défaite lors des élections de mi-mandat de 2026.
fr.headline: Les Républicains choisissent une nouvelle direction à la Chambre après leurs pertes aux élections de mi-mandat

it.body: Il Partito Repubblicano ha scelto Jim Jordan e John Thune come nuovi leader alla Camera dei Rappresentanti, secondo il New York Times. Il partito ha cercato un nuovo vertice in seguito alla sconfitta nelle elezioni di metà mandato del 2026.
it.headline: I Repubblicani scelgono la nuova leadership alla Camera dopo le sconfitte alle elezioni di metà mandato

ja.body: ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、共和党はジム・ジョーダンとジョン・チューンを下院の新たな指導者として選出しました。同党は2026年中間選挙での敗北を受け、新たな指導者を求めていました。
ja.headline: 中間選挙での敗北を受け、共和党が下院の新たな指導者を指名

ko.body: 뉴욕타임스에 따르면 공화당은 2026년 중간선거 패배 후 하원의 새로운 지도부로 짐 조던과 존 튠을 선출했다.
ko.headline: 중간선거 패배 후 공화당, 하원 지도부 새롭게 선출

pt.body: O Partido Republicano escolheu Jim Jordan e John Thune como novos líderes na Câmara dos Representantes, segundo o New York Times. O partido procurou uma nova liderança após a derrota nas eleições de meio de mandato de 2026.
pt.headline: Republicanos elegem nova liderança na Câmara após perdas nas eleições de meio de mandato

zh.body: 据《纽约时报》报道，共和党已选出吉姆·乔丹和约翰·瑟恩为众议院新领导人。该党在2026年中期选举中失利后寻求新的领导层。
zh.headline: 共和党在中期选举失利后选出新众议院领导层

de.body: Wahlbeamte zählen laut G1 auch acht Tage nach den Zwischenwahlen noch immer Stimmzettel. In 17 Wahlbezirken steht ein Endergebnis weiterhin aus.
de.headline: Stimmenauszählung eine Woche nach den US-Zwischenwahlen dauert an

en.body: Election officials are still counting ballots eight days after the midterm elections, according to G1. There are 17 races that remain without a final result.
en.headline: Vote counting continues one week after US midterm elections

es.body: Los funcionarios electorales siguen contando papeletas ocho días después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, según G1. Hay 17 contiendas sin un resultado definitivo.
es.headline: El recuento de votos continúa una semana después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato en EE. UU.

fr.body: Les responsables électoraux continuent de compter les bulletins de vote huit jours après les élections de mi-mandat, selon G1. Dix-sept scrutins n'ont toujours pas de résultat définitif.
fr.headline: Le dépouillement se poursuit une semaine après les élections de mi-mandat aux États-Unis

it.body: I funzionari elettorali stanno ancora contando le schede a otto giorni dalle elezioni di metà mandato, secondo G1. Sono 17 le gare elettorali che rimangono senza un risultato definitivo.
it.headline: Prosegue lo spoglio dei voti a una settimana dalle elezioni di metà mandato negli Stati Uniti

ja.body: G1によると、選挙当局は中間選挙から8日後もまだ投票を集計しています。最終結果が出ていない選挙区は17あります。
ja.headline: 米中間選挙から1週間後も投票集計が継続

ko.body: G1에 따르면 선거 관리 당국은 중간선거 후 8일이 지났음에도 여전히 투표를 집계하고 있으며, 최종 결과가 나오지 않은 선거구는 17곳이다.
ko.headline: 미국 중간선거 후 일주일이 지나도 투표 집계 계속

pt.body: Os responsáveis eleitorais ainda estão a contar boletins oito dias após as eleições de meio de mandato, segundo o G1. Existem 17 disputas sem resultado final.
pt.headline: Contagem de votos continua uma semana após eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA

zh.body: 据G1报道，选举官员在年中期选举后八天仍在计票。仍有17个选区尚未得出最终结果。
zh.headline: 美国中期选举后一周仍在计票
